name: Bjarne
source: Bjarne was the Alpha of the Blue Moon Pack until he was too old to lead. He came out of retirement to become the Beta of his granddaughter [url=/c129641]Naya[/url]. He has immense physical strength despite his old age and is incredibly strong-willed. After the death of his bond mate and son, he lives his life purely to help his granddaughter.
